watervision.config.title: WaterVision Settings
watervision.config.hdr.enableHdrToSdr.to: Enable HDR to SDR tone mapping for HDR video content. Disable if you experience visual issues.
watervision.config.hdr.tonemapMode.toolt: HDR tone mapping algorithm to use.
watervision.config.hdr.forceHdrInShaders: Force HDR tone mapping even when shader mods (Iris/Oculus) are active.
